HexKagune 6.0.2 for Forge 1.20.1 (needs PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon on clients; the server needs only Forge). Install on both the client and the server.

**Fixed in 6.0.2**
- Ayato's Steel Blade no longer stands out to the side in a T-pose. It trails low behind him past his right hip, tip down near the ground and edge down. It streams further back when he runs and rides a little higher when he crouches, and every swing flows from it and back into it. (The blade is about 2.8 blocks long, so it can't hang straight down without going into the ground.)
- Fixed the Steel Blade's edge sometimes flipping half over in a single frame during a swing.
- Ayato's half mask fits the face: no wider than the head, sitting just over the face or over your skin's second layer. It no longer floats off the face with 3D Skin Layers.
- Kaneki's kakugan (and his mask) now stay on his face when he doubles over while transforming, instead of floating in front of his chest.
- Kaneki's idle stance is fixed with 3D Skin Layers (or without bendy-lib), where it showed a broken, stiff-legged lunge: he now stands in a hunched, wide feral stance with his claws out.
- Kaneki's menu no longer shows 2147483647 next to the cut mutations, and the Appearance & Abilities button is gone.
- 6.0.2 works with 6.0.0 and 6.0.1 servers and players.
